standouts.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Apr 9 to Jul 29 (+47%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−3.2% to −9.8%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the May 15 low and the 61.8% retracement of the Mar 9–Jul 29 rise in the same place.
